target_customer: Software companies and enterprises that need penetration testing and compliance evidence (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP)
problem: Penetration tests happen once a year and are slow and expensive. Parameter runs continuous AI agent pentests and verifies findings with working proof of concept.
business_model: B2B security subscription for autonomous pentesting, plus products for cloud, supply chain and pull request review
product_category: AI offensive security and continuous pentesting

founders.name: Ahmad Khan
founders.background_notes: Built on-chain robots; his robot rang the NASDAQ bell. Source: YC company page.

competitors.name: XBOW
competitors.what: Autonomous AI pentesting; topped HackerOne US leaderboard in 2025
competitors.funding_then: reported $75M Series B in June 2025 (secondary source)

competitors.name: Horizon3.ai NodeZero
competitors.traction_then: 170,000+ autonomous tests run per one source

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that find and exploit real vulnerabilities with low false positives and safe execution are hard; the team reports findings across dozens of YC companies.

defensibility.rationale: Well-funded competitors lead the category and agent techniques are replicable; any edge would come from exploit quality and trust.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were already building autonomous pentesting; no Parameter-specific outcome found.

market_need_then: Annual pentests miss continuous change; compliance frameworks require testing. The company claims dozens of critical findings in YC companies and about $1M ARR in a job listing, both self-reported.

branding.domain_note: Moved from hex.co to parameter.ai (site shows Anytool, Inc. as legal entity); the YC page still links hex.co for demos.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct: AI pentesting that works, proof of concept for every finding.

rebrands.why: Reason not stated in any source found

brand_strength.rationale: A rebrand within the first year, a technically evocative name (a security term), but no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Parameter is an active Winter 2026 YC company, formerly Hex Security, with no outcome yet. It targets a hot category with well-funded leaders. Its larger team of 14 and a technical founding team are strengths; confirmed funding and traction are not public.
notes: Funding is unverified: Preqin says an undisclosed seed in January 2026; Neuronfeed says $500K in January 2026; VCBacked says $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund. All aggregators, so none recorded as a round. Founders as listed on YC page, not independently verified. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed rests on VCBacked (listed under the earlier name Hex Security); Neuronfeed and Preqin call it a seed dated January 2026, so stage and date conflict. No press release found.
